label: Own-nature reason, essence-esse sense: x's own token explains its existence iff esse is not distinct
definition: natureModel F essenceOf esseOf is the #312 model on the frame whose only reasons are intrinsic tokens: x's own token explains x's existence at a world exactly when x's represented esse is not distinct from its represented essence, and no other token explains anything. It reads 'existence explained by its own nature' (NECESSARY_EXISTENCE_BY_OWN_NATURE_4, an intrinsic reason token) through essence-esse identity. It does not say that this identity is an adequate reason, or that it gives accessible-world necessity (NECESSARY_EXISTENCE_BY_OWN_NATURE_2).
note: Analyst formulation for the B2 brute-contingency and parity batch (owner direction 2026-11-23); attribution deferred. Used to test the theist asymmetry against B6. See docs/notes/psr-self-application-756.md, 'Brute contingency and parity'.
